787: func failedOperation(r OperationResult, err error) (OperationResult, error) {
788: 	if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
789: 		r.State = OperationCancelled
790: 	} else {
791: 		r.State = OperationFailed
792: 	}
793: 	cause := displaySafe(err.Error())
794: 	code, category, guidance := "internal.error", "internal", "Inspect durable state and retry after correcting the reported cause."
795: 	if smokeErr, ok := sprint.AsSmokeError(err); ok {
796: 		code, category, guidance = smokeErr.Code, smokeErr.Category, smokeErr.Guidance
797: 		r.Message = operationFailureMessage(category)
798: 		r.Error = &OperationError{Code: code, Category: category, Operation: "smoke", Component: "sprint", Message: r.Message, Cause: cause, Guidance: guidance, Retryable: category == "process" || category == "timeout"}
799: 		return r, err
800: 	}
801: 	if qaErr, ok := sprint.AsQAError(err); ok {
802: 		category = string(qaErr.Category)
803: 		code = "qa." + category
804: 		guidance = qaErr.Recovery
805: 		switch qaErr.Category {
806: 		case sprint.QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable, sprint.QAErrorPersistenceFailure:
807: 			category = "runtime"
808: 		case sprint.QAErrorConflict:
809: 			category = "concurrency"
810: 		default:
811: 			category = "validation"
812: 		}
813: 		r.Message = operationFailureMessage(category)
814: 		r.Error = &OperationError{Code: code, Category: category, Operation: "qa", Component: "sprint", Message: r.Message, Cause: cause, Guidance: guidance, Retryable: qaErr.Category == sprint.QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable || qaErr.Category == sprint.QAErrorConflict}
815: 		return r, err
816: 	}
817: 	var projectRef project.RefError
818: 	var sprintRef sprint.RefError
819: 	switch {
820: 	case errors.Is(err, context.Canceled):
821: 		code, category, guidance = "workflow.cancelled", "cancellation", "Resume the operation when ready."
822: 	case errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrFlowStateMalformed), errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrFlowStateUnsupported),
823: 		errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateMissing), errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateMalformed), errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateUnsupported),
824: 		errors.As(err, &projectRef), errors.As(err, &sprintRef), len(r.Findings) > 0:
825: 		code, category, guidance = "validation.reference", "validation", "Complete or repair the reported governed evidence, inspect validation findings, and retry."
826: 	case errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrVerificationConflict), errors.Is(err, ErrStaleOperation):
827: 		code, category, guidance = "workflow.locked", "concurrency", "Inspect the active or stale study lock before retrying."
828: 	}
829: 	r.Message = operationFailureMessage(category)
830: 	r.Error = &OperationError{Code: code, Category: category, Operation: "workflow.operation", Component: "app", Message: r.Message, Cause: cause, Guidance: guidance, Retryable: category == "runtime" || category == "concurrency"}
831: 	return r, err
832: }

911: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
912: 		return ValidationOperationResult{}, err
913: 	}

915: 	switch req.Subject {

924: 		for _, finding := range validation.Findings {
925: 			result.Findings = append(result.Findings, projectFinding(finding))
926: 		}
927: 	case ValidationStudy:

929: 		validation, err := study.NewService(u.root).ValidateStudy(ref)

938: 			}

211: func (u dashboardUseCases) PrepareOperation(ctx context.Context, req OperationRequest) (Confirmation, error) {
212: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
213: 		return Confirmation{}, err
214: 	}
215: 	req.ExpectedFingerprint = ""
216: 	req = normalizeOperationRequest(req)
217: 	if err := validateOperationScope(req); err != nil {
218: 		return Confirmation{}, err
219: 	}
220: 	if err := validateQAOperationRequest(req); err != nil {
221: 		return Confirmation{}, err
222: 	}
223: 	if (req.Kind == OperationReviewStart || req.Kind == OperationReviewDryRun) && req.Parallelism <= 0 {
224: 		req.Parallelism = u.reviewConcurrency
225: 	}
226: 	c := Confirmation{Request: req, Subject: operationFirstNonEmpty(req.Project+"/"+req.Sprint, req.Study), Permission: "workspace policy enforced"}
227: 	switch req.Kind {
228: 	case OperationValidate, OperationPrompt, OperationFlowDryRun, OperationStageDryRun, OperationExecuteDryRun, OperationExecuteStatus, OperationReviewDryRun, OperationReviewStatus, OperationSmokeStatus, OperationQAStatus:
229: 		c.Scope = []string{req.Stage}
230: 		c.Warning = "runtime-free; no runtime-backed writes"
231: 	case OperationQADryRun:
232: 		if req.Suite == "smoke" {
233: 			smoke, err := u.sprintService().RunSmoke(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.SmokeRequest{DryRun: true})
234: 			if err != nil {
235: 				return c, err
236: 			}
237: 			c.Scope = []string{"canonical containing smoke selection", smoke.ScopeKind + " " + smoke.Scope}
238: 			c.Warning = "RUNTIME-FREE SMOKE PREFLIGHT; NO HARNESS INVOCATION"
239: 			break
240: 		}
241: 		mapped, err := u.QAMap(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
242: 		if err != nil {
243: 			return c, err
244: 		}
245: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("deterministic map %s", mapped.MapFingerprint), fmt.Sprintf("%d changed paths in %d bounded shards", mapped.ChangedPaths, mapped.TotalShards)}
246: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME-FREE; TARGET AND GOVERNED INPUTS READ-ONLY; NO QA STATE WRITE"
247: 	case OperationQAStart, OperationQAResume:
248: 		if req.Suite == "smoke" {
249: 			c.Runtime, c.Mutates = true, true
250: 			c.Scope = []string{"one canonical smoke harness invocation", "one smoke.md and flow-state update"}
251: 			c.Warning = "RUNTIME + EXTERNAL HARNESS EVIDENCE; IMPLEMENTATION TARGET READ-ONLY"
252: 			break
253: 		}
254: 		mapped, err := u.QAMap(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
255: 		if err != nil {
256: 			return c, err
257: 		}
258: 		if req.Task != "" {
259: 			owned := false
260: 			for _, shard := range mapped.Shards {
261: 				owned = owned || shard.ID == req.Task
262: 			}
263: 			if !owned {
264: 				return c, fmt.Errorf("selected QA shard is not owned by the current map")
265: 			}
266: 		}
267: 		c.Runtime, c.Mutates = true, true
268: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("deterministic map %s", mapped.MapFingerprint), fmt.Sprintf("bounded concurrency and %d total shards", mapped.TotalShards)}
269: 		if req.Task != "" {
270: 			c.Scope = append(c.Scope, "map-owned shard "+req.Task)
271: 		}
272: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + PRIVATE QA STATE WRITE; IMPLEMENTATION TARGET READ-ONLY"
273: 	case OperationQARecover:
274: 		c.Mutates = true
275: 		c.Scope = []string{"QA pointer, digest, interrupted ownership, flow summary, and retention reconciliation"}
276: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME-FREE QA RECOVERY; NO CHILD WORK"
277: 	case OperationSprintStatus:
278: 		c.Mutates = true
279: 		c.Scope = []string{"all sprint stages", "execute and Conformance Review state"}
280: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME-FREE; MAY REFRESH FLOW-STATE.JSON"
281: 	case OperationFlow:
282: 		c.Runtime = true
283: 		c.Mutates = true
284: 		c.Scope = []string{"planning stages through " + req.Stage}
285: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + WORKSPACE MUTATION"
286: 	case OperationStage:
287: 		c.Runtime = true
288: 		c.Mutates = true
289: 		c.Scope = []string{"selected planning stage only: " + req.Stage}
290: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + WORKSPACE MUTATION; PREREQUISITES MUST ALREADY BE VALID"
291: 	case OperationExecuteStart, OperationExecuteResume:
292: 		c.Runtime = true
293: 		c.Mutates = true
294: 		c.Scope = []string{"execute tasks"}
295: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + APPROVED TARGET MUTATION"
296: 	case OperationReviewStart:
297: 		c.Runtime = true
298: 		c.Mutates = true
299: 		c.Scope = []string{"one read-only Conformance Review worker per selected contract plus handbook", fmt.Sprintf("bounded parallelism: %d", req.Parallelism)}
300: 		if req.RestartReview {
301: 			c.Scope = append(c.Scope, "discard resumable Conformance Review checkpoints and start fresh sessions")
302: 		}
303: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + REVIEW ARTIFACT WRITE (TARGET READ-ONLY)"
304: 	case OperationSmokeDryRun, OperationSmokeStart:
305: 		preview, err := u.sprintService().RunSmoke(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.SmokeRequest{Level: req.Level, Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test, ForceReview: req.ForceReview, OverrideConfirmed: req.ForceReview, OverrideRationale: req.OverrideRationale, DryRun: true})
306: 		if err != nil {
307: 			return c, err
308: 		}
309: 		c.Runtime = true
310: 		c.Mutates = req.Kind == OperationSmokeStart
311: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("%s %s", preview.ScopeKind, preview.Scope), preview.ScopeRationale, "prerequisites: " + strings.Join(preview.Prerequisites, ", "), "duration/cost: " + preview.DurationClass + "/" + preview.CostClass, fmt.Sprintf("timeout: %s (source: %s)", preview.EffectiveTimeout, preview.TimeoutSource), "safe command: " + preview.SafeArgv, "evidence roots: " + strings.Join(preview.EvidenceRoots, ", ")}
312: 		c.Warning = "EXTERNAL HARNESS + SMOKE ARTIFACT WRITE; RAW EVIDENCE REMAINS EXTERNAL"
313: 	case OperationVerifyDryRun, OperationVerifyStart:
314: 		c.Runtime, c.Mutates = true, req.Kind == OperationVerifyStart
315: 		c.Scope = []string{"complete execute evidence", "current Conformance Review", "Conformance Review-gated containing smoke scope"}
316: 		if req.ForceReview {
317: 			c.Scope = append(c.Scope, "DIAGNOSTIC OVERRIDE: "+req.OverrideRationale)
318: 		}
319: 		c.Warning = "ORDERED REVIEW -> SMOKE VERIFICATION; CANONICAL EVIDENCE ONLY AFTER VALIDATION"
320: 	case OperationStudyStart, OperationStudyResume:
321: 		if req.Parallelism < 1 || req.Parallelism > 64 {
322: 			return c, fmt.Errorf("parallelism must be between 1 and 64")
323: 		}
324: 		c.Runtime = true
325: 		c.Mutates = true
326: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("study run-loop with %d parallel workers", req.Parallelism)}
327: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + STUDY STATE MUTATION"
328: 	case OperationStudyCancel:
329: 		c.Mutates = true
330: 		c.Scope = []string{"active study run-loop"}
331: 		c.Warning = "CANCEL ACTIVE RUN LOOP"
332: 	default:
333: 		return c, fmt.Errorf("unsupported operation %q", req.Kind)
334: 	}
335: 	if req.Project != "" {
336: 		if req.Sprint != "" {
337: 			c.Paths = []string{"projects/" + req.Project + "/sprints/" + req.Sprint}
338: 			c.DurableRefreshPath = "/api/v1/projects/" + req.Project + "/sprints/" + req.Sprint
339: 		} else {
340: 			c.Paths = []string{"projects/" + req.Project}
341: 			c.DurableRefreshPath = "/api/v1/projects/" + req.Project
342: 		}
343: 	} else {
344: 		c.Paths = []string{"studies/" + req.Study}
345: 		c.DurableRefreshPath = "/api/v1/studies/" + req.Study
346: 	}
347: 	if c.Mutates {
348: 		if req.Project != "" {
349: 			c.MutationClass = "sprint_mutation"
350: 		} else {
351: 			c.MutationClass = "study_mutation"
352: 		}
353: 	} else {
354: 		c.MutationClass = "read_only"
355: 	}
356: 	if c.Runtime {
357: 		c.ModelSource = operationRuntimeIdentity(req, u.stageRuntime)
358: 	}
359: 	c.Prerequisites = operationPrerequisites(req)
360: 	canonical, err := canonicalOperationRequest(req)
361: 	if err != nil {
362: 		return c, err
363: 	}
364: 	c.CanonicalRequest = canonical
365: 	c.GovernedInputs = governedOperationInputs(req)
366: 	fingerprintBasis := canonical + "\nruntime=" + c.ModelSource + "\nscope=" + strings.Join(c.Scope, "\x00")
367: 	fingerprint, err := fingerprintOperationInputs(u.root, fingerprintBasis, c.GovernedInputs)
368: 	if err != nil {
369: 		return c, err
370: 	}
371: 	c.InputFingerprint = fingerprint
372: 	c.Request.ExpectedFingerprint = fingerprint
373: 	return c, nil
374: }

376: func validateQAOperationRequest(req OperationRequest) error {
377: 	switch req.Kind {
378: 	case OperationQAStatus, OperationQADryRun, OperationQAStart, OperationQAResume, OperationQARecover:
379: 	default:
380: 		return nil
381: 	}
382: 	if req.Study != "" || req.Stage != "" || req.Model != "" || req.Level != "" || req.Test != "" || req.Timeout != "" || req.ForceReview || req.RestartReview || req.OverrideRationale != "" || len(req.ReviewFocus) > 0 || len(req.Sources) > 0 || len(req.Dimensions) > 0 || req.Parallelism != 0 {
383: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA operations accept only project, sprint, and a map-owned shard")
384: 	}
385: 	if req.Suite != "" && req.Suite != "smoke" {
386: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA suite must be smoke")
387: 	}
388: 	if req.Suite != "" && req.Kind != OperationQAStart && req.Kind != OperationQADryRun {
389: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA suite is valid only for start or dry-run")
390: 	}
391: 	if req.Suite != "" && req.Task != "" {
392: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA suite and shard focus are mutually exclusive")
393: 	}
394: 	if req.Task != "" && req.Kind != OperationQAStart && req.Kind != OperationQAResume {
395: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA shard is valid only for start or resume")
396: 	}
397: 	return nil
398: }

400: func (u dashboardUseCases) RunOperation(ctx context.Context, req OperationRequest, emit func(OperationEvent)) (OperationResult, error) {
401: 	expected := req.ExpectedFingerprint
402: 	req.ExpectedFingerprint = ""
403: 	prepared, err := u.PrepareOperation(ctx, req)
404: 	if err != nil {
405: 		return failedOperation(OperationResult{Subject: operationFirstNonEmpty(req.Project+"/"+req.Sprint, req.Study)}, err)
406: 	}
407: 	if expected != "" && expected != prepared.InputFingerprint {
408: 		return failedOperation(OperationResult{Subject: prepared.Subject}, ErrStaleOperation)
409: 	}
410: 	req = prepared.Request
411: 	if emit == nil {
412: 		emit = func(OperationEvent) {}
413: 	}
414: 	emit(OperationEvent{State: OperationRunning, Stage: req.Stage, Message: "operation started"})
415: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
416: 		return OperationResult{State: OperationCancelled}, err
417: 	}
418: 	ss := u.sprintService()
419: 	result := OperationResult{State: OperationComplete, Subject: operationFirstNonEmpty(req.Project+"/"+req.Sprint, req.Study)}
420: 	stage := sprint.PlanningStage(req.Stage)
421: 	switch req.Kind {
422: 	case OperationValidate:
423: 		validationReq := ValidationRequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint, Study: req.Study, Stage: req.Stage}
424: 		switch {
425: 		case req.Study != "":
426: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationStudy
427: 		case req.Sprint != "":
428: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationSprint
429: 		default:
430: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationProject
431: 		}
432: 		validation, err := u.Validate(ctx, validationReq)
433: 		if err != nil {
434: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
435: 		}
436: 		result.Message = validation.Status
437: 		result.Findings = append(result.Findings, validation.Findings...)
438: 	case OperationSprintStatus:
439: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
440: 		if err != nil {
441: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
442: 		}
443: 		result.Message = summarizeSprintStatus(r)
444: 	case OperationPrompt:
445: 		p, err := promptSprintStage(ss, req.Project, req.Sprint, stage)
446: 		if err != nil {
447: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
448: 		}
449: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(p.Prompt)
450: 	case OperationFlowDryRun:
451: 		r, err := runSprintFlow(ctx, ss, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.FlowRequest{To: stage, DryRun: true})
452: 		if err != nil {
453: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
454: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
455: 		}
456: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Message)
457: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("flow to %s dry run", stage)
458: 	case OperationStageDryRun:
459: 		r, err := ss.FlowStage(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.FlowRequest{To: stage, DryRun: true})
460: 		if err != nil {
461: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
462: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
463: 		}
464: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Message)
465: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("single-stage %s dry run", stage)
466: 	case OperationExecuteDryRun:
467: 		r, err := ss.Execute(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.ExecuteRequest{DryRun: true, TaskID: req.Task})
468: 		if err != nil {
469: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
470: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
471: 		}
472: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Prompt)
473: 		result.Message = r.Message
474: 	case OperationExecuteStatus:
475: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
476: 		if err != nil {
477: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
478: 		}
479: 		execute := summarizeExecute(r.ExecuteState)
480: 		if !execute.Available {
481: 			result.Message = execute.Message
482: 		} else {
483: 			result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%d total: %d pending, %d running, %d complete, %d failed, %d cancelled", execute.Total, execute.Pending, execute.Running, execute.Complete, execute.Failed, execute.Cancelled)
484: 		}
485: 	case OperationReviewDryRun:
486: 		r, err := ss.Review(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.ReviewRequest{DryRun: true, Concurrency: req.Parallelism})
487: 		if err != nil {
488: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
489: 		}
490: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Prompt)
491: 		result.Message = r.Message
492: 	case OperationReviewStatus:
493: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
494: 		if err != nil {
495: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
496: 		}
497: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%s verdict=%s fresh=%t next=%s", r.Verification.Review.ExecutionStatus, r.Verification.Review.Verdict, r.Verification.Review.Fresh, r.Verification.Review.NextAction)
498: 	case OperationSmokeStatus:
499: 		r, err := ss.VerificationStatus(req.Project, req.Sprint)
500: 		if err != nil {
501: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
502: 		}
503: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%s verdict=%s fresh=%t run=%s issues=%d assessment=%s next=%s", r.Smoke.ExecutionStatus, r.Smoke.Verdict, r.Smoke.Fresh, r.Smoke.RunID, len(r.Smoke.Issues), r.Assessment, r.NextAction)
504: 	case OperationSmokeDryRun:
505: 		r, err := ss.RunSmoke(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.SmokeRequest{Level: req.Level, Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test, ForceReview: req.ForceReview, OverrideConfirmed: req.ForceReview, OverrideRationale: req.OverrideRationale, DryRun: true})
506: 		if err != nil {
507: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
508: 		}
509: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s: %s", r.ScopeKind, r.Scope, r.ScopeRationale)
510: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(sprint.RenderSmoke(r))
511: 	case OperationQAStatus:
512: 		qa, err := u.QAStatus(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
513: 		if err != nil {
514: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
515: 		}
516: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("phase=%s fresh=%t shards=%d/%d next=%s", qa.Phase, qa.Fresh, qa.CompletedShards, qa.TotalShards, qa.NextAction)
517: 	case OperationQADryRun:
518: 		if req.Suite == "smoke" {
519: 			smoke, err := ss.RunSmoke(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.SmokeRequest{DryRun: true})
520: 			if err != nil {
521: 				return failedOperation(result, err)
522: 			}
523: 			result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("smoke suite ready: %s %s", smoke.ScopeKind, smoke.Scope)
524: 			result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(sprint.RenderSmoke(smoke))
525: 			break
526: 		}
527: 		qa, err := u.QAMap(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
528: 		if err != nil {
529: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
530: 		}
531: 		data, _ := json.MarshalIndent(qa, "", "  ")
532: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(string(data))
533: 		result.Message = "read-only QA map ready"
534: 	case OperationQARecover:
535: 		qa, err := u.RecoverQA(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
536: 		if err != nil {
537: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
538: 		}
539: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("phase=%s next=%s", qa.Phase, qa.NextAction)
540: 	case OperationVerifyDryRun:
541: 		r, err := ss.Verify(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.VerifyRequest{To: sprint.PlanningStage(req.Stage), DryRun: true, Review: sprint.ReviewRequest{DryRun: true, Focus: req.ReviewFocus, Restart: req.RestartReview}, Smoke: sprint.SmokeRequest{Level: req.Level, Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test, ForceReview: req.ForceReview, OverrideConfirmed: req.ForceReview, OverrideRationale: req.OverrideRationale, DryRun: true}})
542: 		if err != nil {
543: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
544: 		}
545: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("assessment=%s next=%s", r.Verification.Assessment, r.Verification.NextAction)
546: 	default:
547: 		if u.runner == nil {
548: 			return failedOperation(result, fmt.Errorf("runtime-backed operation is unavailable without configured composition"))
549: 		}
550: 		return u.runner(ctx, req, emit)
551: 	}
552: 	emit(OperationEvent{State: OperationComplete, Stage: req.Stage, Message: operationFirstNonEmpty(result.Message, "operation complete")})
553: 	return result, nil

699: func fingerprintOperationInputs(root, canonical string, inputs []string) (string, error) {
700: 	hash := sha256.New()
701: 	_, _ = hash.Write([]byte(canonical))
702: 	for _, rel := range inputs {
703: 		path := filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(rel))
704: 		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
705: 		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
706: 			continue
707: 		}
708: 		if err != nil {
709: 			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect governed input %s: %w", rel, err)
710: 		}
711: 		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
712: 			return "", fmt.Errorf("governed input %s must not be a symbolic link", rel)
713: 		}
714: 		if info.IsDir() {
715: 			var files []string
716: 			if err := filepath.WalkDir(path, func(item string, entry fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
717: 				if walkErr != nil {
718: 					return walkErr
719: 				}
720: 				if entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
721: 					return fmt.Errorf("governed input %s must not contain symbolic links", rel)
722: 				}
723: 				if !entry.IsDir() {
724: 					files = append(files, item)
725: 				}
726: 				return nil
727: 			}); err != nil {
728: 				return "", fmt.Errorf("scan governed input %s: %w", rel, err)
729: 			}
730: 			sort.Strings(files)
731: 			for _, item := range files {
732: 				itemRel, _ := filepath.Rel(root, item)
733: 				if err := hashOperationFile(hash, item, filepath.ToSlash(itemRel)); err != nil {
734: 					return "", err
735: 				}
736: 			}
737: 			continue
738: 		}
739: 		if err := hashOperationFile(hash, path, rel); err != nil {
740: 			return "", err
741: 		}
742: 	}
743: 	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), nil
744: }

746: func hashOperationFile(hash interface{ Write([]byte) (int, error) }, path, rel string) error {
747: 	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)

749: 		return fmt.Errorf("read governed input %s: %w", rel, err)
750: 	}
751: 	_, _ = hash.Write([]byte("\x00" + rel + "\x00"))
752: 	_, _ = hash.Write(data)
753: 	return nil
754: }

788: 	if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {

790: 	} else {
791: 		r.State = OperationFailed
792: 	}
793: 	cause := displaySafe(err.Error())
794: 	code, category, guidance := "internal.error", "internal", "Inspect durable state and retry after correcting the reported cause."
795: 	if smokeErr, ok := sprint.AsSmokeError(err); ok {
796: 		code, category, guidance = smokeErr.Code, smokeErr.Category, smokeErr.Guidance
797: 		r.Message = operationFailureMessage(category)
798: 		r.Error = &OperationError{Code: code, Category: category, Operation: "smoke", Component: "sprint", Message: r.Message, Cause: cause, Guidance: guidance, Retryable: category == "process" || category == "timeout"}
799: 		return r, err
800: 	}
801: 	if qaErr, ok := sprint.AsQAError(err); ok {
802: 		category = string(qaErr.Category)
803: 		code = "qa." + category
804: 		guidance = qaErr.Recovery
805: 		switch qaErr.Category {
806: 		case sprint.QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable, sprint.QAErrorPersistenceFailure:
807: 			category = "runtime"
808: 		case sprint.QAErrorConflict:
809: 			category = "concurrency"
810: 		default:
811: 			category = "validation"
812: 		}
813: 		r.Message = operationFailureMessage(category)
814: 		r.Error = &OperationError{Code: code, Category: category, Operation: "qa", Component: "sprint", Message: r.Message, Cause: cause, Guidance: guidance, Retryable: qaErr.Category == sprint.QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable || qaErr.Category == sprint.QAErrorConflict}
815: 		return r, err
816: 	}
817: 	var projectRef project.RefError
818: 	var sprintRef sprint.RefError
819: 	switch {
820: 	case errors.Is(err, context.Canceled):
821: 		code, category, guidance = "workflow.cancelled", "cancellation", "Resume the operation when ready."
822: 	case errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrFlowStateMalformed), errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrFlowStateUnsupported),
823: 		errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateMissing), errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateMalformed), errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateUnsupported),
824: 		errors.As(err, &projectRef), errors.As(err, &sprintRef), len(r.Findings) > 0:
825: 		code, category, guidance = "validation.reference", "validation", "Complete or repair the reported governed evidence, inspect validation findings, and retry."
826: 	case errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrVerificationConflict), errors.Is(err, ErrStaleOperation):
827: 		code, category, guidance = "workflow.locked", "concurrency", "Inspect the active or stale study lock before retrying."
828: 	}
829: 	r.Message = operationFailureMessage(category)
830: 	r.Error = &OperationError{Code: code, Category: category, Operation: "workflow.operation", Component: "app", Message: r.Message, Cause: cause, Guidance: guidance, Retryable: category == "runtime" || category == "concurrency"}
831: 	return r, err
832: }

reasoning_details.text:
Now I have the core. Let me note candidate issues already:

**Candidate A (durable_operations.go:106-112)**: When `AcceptOperation` hits a conflict on digest, it returns `AcceptedOperation{Context: ctx, Existing: true}` — with `ctx` being the raw caller ctx, not an operation context with ownership values. For web/TUI that's fine since Existing means "don't run". But wait — in `beginDurableCLICommand`, digest is always "" so no conflict path. OK.

But more interesting: **the alias conflict resolution is not atomic** — between Accept failing and ResolveOperationAlias, fine. But what about the case where `Accept` fails with ErrConflict but for a *different* reason than alias conflict? E.g., quota refusal? Let me check runcontrol.Accept error semantics. If ErrConflict can be returned for other reasons (e.g., concurrent accept?), then ResolveOperationAlias would fail with not-found and return joined error. That's handled.

**Candidate B**: In `AcceptOperation` success path — Claim failure returns error *after* the run row was accepted. So a run row exists in "prepared"/accepted lifecycle with no claim and no terminal. Is there reconciliation? The startup Reconcile handles interrupted mutations. Need to check runcontrol.ReconcileInterruptedMutation / lifecycle handling of "accepted" runs with no claim. This belongs to spine surface mostly, but from this surface's perspective: if Claim fails, AcceptOperation returns error → CLI command aborts; the run row remains accepted-never-running forever? Reconciliation may mark it interrupted. Probably spine's concern.

**Candidate C**: `RecordOperationEvent` — when append fails, calls `owned.cancel()` which cancels the operation context. But it doesn't remove owned from map... Finish will still find it. OK. But note: after cancel, subsequent RecordOperationEvent calls will try to append again and fail again → each failure cancels repeatedly (no-op). Fine.

**Candidate D — coalescing race**: `RecordOperationEvent` holds `eventMu` across repository write — serializes events per operation. Fine.

**Candidate E — FinishOperation ordering**: `close(owned.stop)`, `<-owned.done`, then cancel. Wait — control goroutine exits either on stop or ctx.Done. Then propose terminal. But consider: control goroutine may be blocked in `m.repository.Snapshot(ctx...)` with ctx = operationCtx. If the operationCtx was cancelled by RecordOperationEvent failure or by cancellation acknowledge, Snapshot returns error → cancel() → return → done closed. OK.

But there's a subtle deadlock possibility: `FinishOperation` waits `<-owned.done`. The control loop uses `ctx` (operationCtx). If the operation is long-running and the caller's ctx (parent of operationCtx via WithCancel(runcontrol.WithParentRun(ctx,...))) is fine. Hmm, `WithParentRun(ctx)` — need to check what that does; probably stores value + keeps parent. If parent ctx cancelled → operationCtx cancelled → control loop exits → done closes. OK.

What about `FinishOperation` called with ctx that has 30s timeout (CLI finish). proposeRunTerminalWithRetry with retry — could take longer than 30s? Bounded retries presumably.

**Candidate F — FinishOperation outcome mapping vs state**: `state == OperationPartial` maps to TerminalInterrupted, but the switch order: `case errors.Is(runErr, context.Canceled), state == OperationCancelled:` comes before partial. If state==partial AND runErr==nil, falls to partial case. OK. But note `case runErr != nil, state == OperationFailed` before partial: if state==partial and runErr != nil → failed. Fine.

**Candidate G — durableCLICommand.Finish precedence**: checks `c.accepted.Context.Err() != nil` first → cancelled even if runErr non-nil. If command failed with real error while ctx also cancelled (e.g., SIGINT during failing command), records cancelled instead of failed. Minor semantic choice.

More importantly: **Finish(runErr) with state==OperationComplete but Context cancelled → cancelled**. And FinishOperation maps `errors.Is(runErr, context.DeadlineExceeded)` → TerminalTimedOut only when Context.Err()==nil. If deadline exceeded, Context would be cancelled too (parent deadline), so Context.Err() != nil → OperationCancelled → TerminalCancelled. So TerminalTimedOut unreachable from CLI finish unless runErr wraps DeadlineExceeded from a child context. Hmm — that's a real subtlety: `durableCLICommand.Finish`: if `c.accepted.Context.Err() == nil` but runErr is context.DeadlineExceeded (child timeout), state=Failed... then FinishOperation switch: `errors.Is(runErr, context.DeadlineExceeded)` → TimedOut. Good.

**Candidate H — hub start / dedup**: need to read internal/web/operations.go and security.go.

**Candidate I — TUI digest**: content-hash based idempotency: sha256(CanonicalRequest+"\x00"+InputFingerprint). CanonicalRequest includes ExpectedFingerprint cleared... wait, canonical clears ExpectedFingerprint, and fingerprint basis includes canonical+runtime+scope. The InputFingerprint hashes governed inputs at prepare time. Two identical TUI operations confirmed at different times produce same digest IF inputs unchanged → second gets Existing → no duplicate run. But what if the first completed and user wants to re-run the same action deliberately (e.g., qa-resume after progress)? The alias still resolves → "matching durable operation already exists" and refuses to run! Unless alias rows get cleaned up/compacted. This is a potential liveness/usability defect: TUI cannot repeat an identical operation until alias pruned. Need to check alias retention in runcontrol (spine surface, but consequence lands here). Also check whether ResolveOperationAlias excludes terminal/compacted runs. Let me read sqlite.go ResolveOperationAlias.

Also **TUI digest collision across different kinds**: digest includes full canonical request JSON including Kind, so no cross-kind collision.

**Candidate J — web dedup key = sha256(session+"\x00"+token)**: token is per-preparation random? Let me check preparationStore. If token is random per prepare, replay works within session. Cross-session duplicates allowed by design.

**Candidate K — cancellation reasons divergence**: web "user_request" vs TUI/CLI "user_requested". Any consumer that filters reasons? run_handlers rendering. If purely display, cosmetic-ish. But contract tests may pin. Check.

**Candidate L — CancelQA membership gate**: CancelQA requires Target.Operation ∈ {qa-start, qa-resume} else "QA run does not belong to the selected sprint". What about cancelling a qa-start operation whose Target.Project matches but sprint empty? Edge.

**Candidate M — readOnly split serve vs TUI**: TUI Status may rewrite flow-state.json — that's disclosed in tuiHelp. Not a defect per se (documented), though help contradiction ("read-only terminal dashboard") is doc-level. Skip as cosmetic unless it creates concrete failure: e.g., TUI refresh mutating flow-state.json concurrently with a running flow operation → corruption? Sprint service likely has locks. Out of scope maybe.

**Candidate N — triplicated polling loops**: `run follow` exit condition `terminal ∧ after≥LastSequence`; web fallback identical; TUI fetches RunEvents(after=OldestRetainedSequence−1, limit 200) every tick — if more than 200 events pending, TUI shows only newest 200? Actually RunEvents(after=..., limit=200) — which end? If it returns oldest-first limited to 200, TUI misses later ones until next tick catches up. At 1 Hz with limit 200, sustained >200 events/s would lag indefinitely. ProgressCoalesceWindow mitigates. Probably fine.

Let me now read the web hub operations.go and security.go, plus operation_handlers.go relevant parts.

479: func (h *operationHub) drainAndWait(ctx context.Context) error {
480: 	h.mu.Lock()
481: 	h.draining = true
482: 	var records []*operationRecord
483: 	for _, record := range h.records {
484: 		if !terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
485: 			records = append(records, record)
486: 		}
487: 	}
488: 	h.mu.Unlock()
489: 	for _, record := range records {

491: 	}
492: 	h.counters.shutdownCleanups.Add(int64(len(records)))

494: 		select {
495: 		case <-record.done:

505: func (h *operationHub) persistCleanupUncertain(records []*operationRecord) error {

512: 		h.mu.Lock()

514: 		h.mu.Unlock()

517: 		}

519: 		err := recorder.RecordOperationCleanupUncertain(persistCtx, app.OperationCleanupUncertain{
520: 			OperationID: record.doc.ID,
521: 			Request:     record.request,
522: 			Reason:      "server_shutdown",
523: 			RecordedAt:  h.now().UTC(),

533: func (h *operationHub) markCleanupUncertain(records []*operationRecord) {

538: 		if terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
539: 			continue
540: 		}

542: 		record.doc.Reason = "server_shutdown"
543: 		record.doc.FinishedAt = &finished

550: 		for id, subscriber := range record.subscribers {

552: 			delete(record.subscribers, id)

577: func projectOperationResult(result app.OperationResult) *operationResultDTO {

233: 	})

235: 		finishCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
236: 		finishErr := manager.FinishOperation(finishCtx, record.doc.ID, result.State, runErr)

279: func (h *operationHub) finish(record *operationRecord, result app.OperationResult, runErr error) {

282: 	defer h.mu.Unlock()

284: 		return

287: 	switch {

reasoning_details.text:
Very interesting findings in the hub already. Let me note candidates:

**Candidate W1 — `startConfirmed` holds `h.mu` across `AcceptOperation` (a DB write) and `confirm()` (re-prepare: hashing all governed input files, potentially running a full smoke dry-run preview for smoke-start/QA prep!).** `confirm()` calls the handler's confirm func which re-runs PrepareOperation — which for smoke kinds runs `RunSmoke(DryRun:true)` (filesystem scans, maybe harness preflight?) and fingerprints every governed file (reading entire files). All under the hub's global mutex. Consequences:
- Liveness: while any start is in flight (including its DB accept + full file hashing), all other hub operations block: status polling, event subscription (SSE), cancel, drain. A slow disk or big workspace → SSE heartbeats stall? Actually heartbeat is separate goroutine probably; but subscribe/status/cancel all block on h.mu. Cancellation of another operation blocked → cancel latency spikes. This is a real concurrency defect candidate: global lock held across expensive I/O.
- Also `AcceptOperation` inside lock does Claim + event append + spawns control goroutine. And `manager.AcceptOperation` → repository.Accept → SQLite write with possible compaction (soft-quota!). Compaction could take a long time. Under h.mu.

But is this "concrete observable bad outcome"? With 8 active ops and typical local usage... PrepareOperation hashing governed inputs reads whole files including docs dir walk. For large workspaces this could take seconds. Meanwhile status/SSE subscribe requests block → HTTP hangs. Not corruption but liveness degradation. Medium/low severity, medium-high confidence that the lock is held across I/O. Let me verify `startConfirmed` callers pass a confirm func that re-prepares: operation_handlers.go startConfirmed(session, dedupKey, func(){ return u.PrepareOperation... }). Need to check.

**Candidate W2 — dedup map vs durable alias double-bookkeeping race**: `h.dedup[dedupKey] = id` where id = accepted.RunID when durable. Two concurrent same-session+token starts: preparationStore token consumption presumably single-use (security.go). Check whether token consumption is atomic — if two concurrent starts with same token both pass store check, both call AcceptOperation with same digest; first accepts, second gets alias conflict → Existing → returns doc without starting. Good defense. But wait — the second one returns `Existing` doc built from `prepared.Request.Kind`, fine.

However there's a subtle bug: in `startConfirmed`, when durable accept succeeds and `accepted.Existing` is false, `id = accepted.RunID` — then record created keyed by run ID. But if `dedupKey == ""` (hub.start test-only path), no dedup entry. Fine.

**Candidate W3 — hub.run finish ordering vs cancellation**: When cancelled via ctx, RunOperation returns OperationResult{State: cancelled} + err context.Canceled → failedOperation? No wait, RunOperation in-process paths return via failedOperation only on error. For runner-backed ops (sharedOperationRunner), need to check what it returns when ctx cancelled mid-run. Then FinishOperation(finishCtx, record.doc.ID, result.State, runErr) → proposes terminal cancelled. Good parity.

**Candidate W4 — `publishAppEvent` uses `context.Background()` for RecordOperationEvent**: after cancellation, events still recorded? RecordOperationEvent appends with retry using Background ctx even though operation cancelled — minor.

More important: **when RecordOperationEvent fails, publishAppEvent cancels the record but doesn't mark it terminal**. The run goroutine's RunOperation will see ctx cancelled and return; finish() then marks state cancelled/failed. OK.

**Candidate W5 — drainAndWait waits on records captured before cancelling; but `markCleanupUncertain` closes record.done and decrements h.active — however `finish()` may also run later for those records (RunOperation returns after cancel; finish sees terminalOperationState true → early return). Good.

But **drainAndWait deadlock candidate**: records list captured under lock; cancelOperation called per id with empty session (bypasses session check intentionally). If a record was already terminal by the time cancelOperation runs → fine. If record not found (reaped?) can't be reaped since non-terminal. OK.

What about operations whose RunOperation ignores ctx cancellation (e.g., a stage in a subprocess)? drain waits until ctx deadline → persistCleanupUncertain + markCleanupUncertain. The underlying RunOperation goroutine keeps running post-shutdown (goroutine leak past server exit — process exits anyway).

**Candidate W6 — `cancelOperation` sets `record.doc.Reason = canonicalCancelReason(reason)` only inside cancelOnce. Second cancel attempt returns current doc — good idempotency. But note: `record.cancelOnce` also guards against multiple cancel() invocations.

**Candidate W7 — In `startConfirmed`, if durable manager exists but AcceptOperation returns ErrWebUnavailable... wait, ErrWebUnavailable comes from repositoryRunUseCases, not from durableOperationManager. durableOperationManager wraps real repository; would never return ErrWebUnavailable. 78: func newSecurityMiddleware(authority string, diagnostics io.Writer, now func() time.Time, requestID func() string) *securityMiddleware {
79: 	if diagnostics == nil {
80: 		diagnostics = io.Discard
81: 	}
82: 	if now == nil {
83: 		now = time.Now
84: 	}
85: 	if requestID == nil {
86: 		requestID = randomRequestID
87: 	}
88: 	m := &securityMiddleware{

90: 		origin:      "http://" + authority,
91: 		diagnostics: diagnostics,
92: 		now:         now,
93: 		requestID:   requestID,
94: 		sem:         make(chan struct{}, MaxInFlight),
95: 	}
96: 	if _, err := rand.Read(m.secret[:]); err != nil {
97: 		m.secret = sha256.Sum256([]byte(authority + now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano)))

102: func (m *securityMiddleware) wrap(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
103: 	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
104: 		started := m.now()
105: 		tracked := &trackedWriter{ResponseWriter: w}
106: 		applySecurityHeaders(tracked.Header())
107: 		id := m.requestID()
108: 		tracked.Header().Set("X-Request-ID", id)
109: 		r = r.WithContext(context.WithValue(r.Context(), requestIDKey{}, id))
110: 		session, validSession := m.readSession(r)
111: 		if !validSession {
112: 			session = randomRequestID()
113: 			http.SetCookie(tracked, &http.Cookie{Name: "ultraplan_session", Value: m.signSession(session), Path: "/", HttpOnly: true, SameSite: http.SameSiteStrictMode, MaxAge: 3600})
114: 		}
115: 		csrf := m.csrfFor(session)
116: 		tracked.Header().Set("X-CSRF-Token", csrf)
117: 		ctx := context.WithValue(r.Context(), sessionIDKey{}, session)
118: 		ctx = context.WithValue(ctx, csrfTokenKey{}, csrf)
119: 		r = r.WithContext(ctx)
120: 
121: 		select {
122: 		case m.sem <- struct{}{}:
123: 			m.active.Add(1)
124: 			defer func() {
125: 				m.active.Add(-1)
126: 				<-m.sem
127: 			}()
128: 		case <-r.Context().Done():
129: 			m.reject(tracked, r, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "unavailable", "The service is unavailable.")
130: 			return
131: 		}
132: 
133: 		matchedRoute := matchRoute(r.URL.Path)
134: 		apiOperationMutation := (r.Method == http.MethodPost || r.Method == http.MethodDelete) && strings.HasPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/api/v1/operations")
135: 		apiRunMutation := r.Method == http.MethodDelete && matchedRoute.name == "api_run"
136: 		htmlOperationMutation := r.Method == http.MethodPost && strings.HasPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/operations/")
137: 		htmlSprintMutation := r.Method == http.MethodPost && matchedRoute.name == "sprint_create"
138: 		htmlRunMutation := r.Method == http.MethodPost && matchedRoute.name == "run_cancel"
139: 		operationMutation := apiOperationMutation || apiRunMutation || htmlOperationMutation || htmlSprintMutation || htmlRunMutation
140: 		operationRead := (r.Method == http.MethodGet || r.Method == http.MethodHead) && (matchedRoute.name == "api_operation" || matchedRoute.name == "api_operation_events")
141: 		staticAsset := (r.Method == http.MethodGet || r.Method == http.MethodHead) && strings.HasPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/static/")
142: 		hasBody := r.ContentLength > 0 || len(r.TransferEncoding) > 0
143: 		operationBody := r.Method == http.MethodPost && (matchedRoute.name == "api_operation_prepare" || matchedRoute.name == "api_operations" || matchedRoute.name == "operation_prepare" || matchedRoute.name == "operation_start" || matchedRoute.name == "operation_cancel" || matchedRoute.name == "run_cancel" || matchedRoute.name == "sprint_create")
144: 		switch {
145: 		case len(r.RequestURI) > MaxRequestTarget:
146: 			m.reject(tracked, r, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request", "The request target is too long.")
147: 		case ambiguousRequestFraming(r):
148: 			m.reject(tracked, r, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request", "The request framing is ambiguous.")
149: 		case r.Host != m.authority:
150: 			m.reject(tracked, r, http.StatusForbidden, "host_rejected", hostRejectionMessage(m.authority, r.Host))
151: 		case operationMutation && !validSession:
152: 			m.reject(tracked, r, http.StatusForbidden, "session_required", "Establish a browser session before submitting commands.")
153: 		case operationMutation && !validCommandRequestOrigin(r, m.origin):
154: 			m.reject(tracked, r, http.StatusForbidden, "origin_rejected", originRejectionMessage(m.origin, r.Header.Get("Origin")))
155: 		case (apiOperationMutation || apiRunMutation) && subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(r.Header.Get("X-CSRF-Token")), []byte(csrf)) != 1:
156: 			m.reject(tracked, r, http.StatusForbidden, "csrf_failed", "The CSRF proof did not match this browser session. Refresh the UltraPlan page and prepare the operation again.")

158: 			m.reject(tracked, r, http.StatusForbidden, "origin_rejected", originRejectionMessage(m.origin, r.Header.Get("Origin")))
159: 		case !operationMutation && !operationRead && !staticAsset && !validReadRequestOrigin(r, m.origin):
160: 			m.reject(tracked, r, http.StatusForbidden, "origin_rejected", originRejectionMessage(m.origin, r.Header.Get("Origin")))
161: 		case r.ContentLength > MaxBodyBytes:
162: 			m.reject(tracked, r, http.StatusRequestEntityTooLarge, "request_too_large", "The request is too large.")
163: 		case hasBody && !operationBody:
164: 			m.reject(tracked, r, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request", "Request bodies are not accepted.")

166: 			if operationBody {
167: 				r.Body = http.MaxBytesReader(tracked, r.Body, MaxBodyBytes)

171: 		if tracked.status == 0 {
172: 			tracked.status = http.StatusOK
173: 		}
174: 		fmt.Fprintf(m.diagnostics,
175: 			"event=http_request request_id=%s route=%s method=%s status=%d duration_ms=%d response_bytes=%d\n",
176: 			id, normalizedRoute(r.URL.Path), r.Method, tracked.status, m.now().Sub(started).Milliseconds(), tracked.bytes)

180: func ambiguousRequestFraming(r *http.Request) bool {
181: 	contentLengths := r.Header.Values("Content-Length")

187: 	writePolicyError(w, r, status, code, message)

190: func originRejectionMessage(expected, received string) string {

192: }

194: func hostRejectionMessage(expected, received string) string {
195: 	return fmt.Sprintf("The request used host %s, but this server is listening as %s. Open the exact Dashboard URL printed by UltraPlan.", displayAuthority(received), expected)
196: }

198: func displayOrigin(value string) string {
199: 	if value == "" {
200: 		return "a request with no Origin header"
201: 	}
202: 	if value == "null" {
203: 		return "the opaque origin 'null'"
204: 	}
205: 	parsed, err := url.Parse(value)
206: 	if err != nil || parsed.Scheme == "" || parsed.Host == "" || parsed.User != nil {
207: 		return "an invalid origin"
208: 	}
209: 	return parsed.Scheme + "://" + displayAuthority(parsed.Host)

212: func displayAuthority(value string) string {
213: 	value = strings.Map(func(r rune) rune {
214: 		if r < 0x20 || r == 0x7f {
215: 			return -1
216: 		}
217: 		return r
218: 	}, value)
219: 	if len(value) > 256 {
220: 		value = value[:256] + "…"
221: 	}
222: 	if value == "" {
223: 		return "an empty host"
224: 	}
225: 	return value
226: }

228: func (m *securityMiddleware) signSession(session string) string {
229: 	mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, m.secret[:])
230: 	_, _ = mac.Write([]byte("session:" + session))
231: 	return session + "." + hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))

234: func (m *securityMiddleware) readSession(r *http.Request) (string, bool) {
235: 	cookie, err := r.Cookie("ultraplan_session")
236: 	if err != nil {
237: 		return "", false
238: 	}
239: 	parts := strings.Split(cookie.Value, ".")
240: 	if len(parts) != 2 || len(parts[0]) != 32 {
241: 		return "", false
242: 	}
243: 	expected := m.signSession(parts[0])
244: 	return parts[0], subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(cookie.Value), []byte(expected)) == 1

253: func applySecurityHeaders(header http.Header) {
254: 	header.Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
255: 	header.Set("Content-Security-Policy", "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'")
256: 	header.Set("Referrer-Policy", "same-origin")
257: 	header.Set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
258: 	header.Set("X-Frame-Options", "DENY")
259: 	header.Set("Permissions-Policy", "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()")

262: func validOrigin(origin, expected string) bool {
263: 	if origin == "" {
264: 		return true
265: 	}
266: 	return validCommandOrigin(origin, expected)
267: }
268: 
269: // validCommandOrigin permits a browser shell or local reverse proxy to omit or
270: // rewrite only the port while preserving the exact numeric loopback address.
271: // Mutating requests still require the signed session and CSRF proof.
272: func validCommandOrigin(origin, expected string) bool {
273: 	return origin == expected
274: }
275: 
276: // validCommandRequestOrigin accepts the exact configured origin. It also
277: // tolerates browsers that remove a non-default port from Origin when their
278: // unforgeable fetch metadata and exact Referer still prove a same-origin
279: // request. Session and CSRF validation remain separate mandatory checks.
280: func validCommandRequestOrigin(r *http.Request, expected string) bool {
281: 	if validCommandOrigin(r.Header.Get("Origin"), expected) {
282: 		return true
283: 	}
284: 	if r.Header.Get("Sec-Fetch-Site") != "same-origin" {
285: 		return false
286: 	}
287: 	receivedURL, receivedErr := url.Parse(r.Header.Get("Origin"))
288: 	expectedURL, expectedErr := url.Parse(expected)
289: 	refererURL, refererErr := url.Parse(r.Header.Get("Referer"))
290: 	if receivedErr != nil || expectedErr != nil || refererErr != nil ||
291: 		receivedURL.User != nil || expectedURL.User != nil || refererURL.User != nil {
292: 		return false
293: 	}
294: 	return receivedURL.Scheme == expectedURL.Scheme &&
295: 		receivedURL.Hostname() == expectedURL.Hostname() &&
296: 		receivedURL.Port() == "" && expectedURL.Port() != "" &&
297: 		refererURL.Scheme+"://"+refererURL.Host == expected
298: }

300: func validOperationReadOrigin(origin, expected string) bool {
301: 	return origin == "" || validCommandOrigin(origin, expected)
302: }

304: func validOperationReadRequestOrigin(r *http.Request, expected string) bool {
305: 	return r.Header.Get("Origin") == "" || validCommandRequestOrigin(r, expected)
306: }

308: // validReadRequestOrigin applies the browser's same-origin proofs to ordinary
309: // read-only pages and APIs too. Some browser shells normalize a loopback
310: // Origin by dropping its non-default port, even though Host and Referer retain
311: // the exact authority. Mutations continue through the stricter command path.
312: func validReadRequestOrigin(r *http.Request, expected string) bool {
313: 	return r.Header.Get("Origin") == "" || validCommandRequestOrigin(r, expected)
314: }

339: func normalizedRoute(path string) string {
340: 	switch {
341: 	case path == "/":
342: 		return "dashboard"
343: 	case path == "/projects":
344: 		return "projects"
345: 	case strings.HasPrefix(path, "/projects/") && strings.Contains(path, "/sprints/"):
346: 		return "sprint_detail"
347: 	case strings.HasPrefix(path, "/projects/"):
348: 		return "project_detail"
349: 	case path == "/studies":
350: 		return "studies"
351: 	case strings.HasPrefix(path, "/studies/"):
352: 		return "study_detail"
353: 	case strings.HasPrefix(path, "/artifacts/"):
354: 		return "artifact"
355: 	case strings.HasPrefix(path, "/api/v1/artifacts/"):
356: 		return "api_artifact"
357: 	case strings.HasPrefix(path, "/api/v1/"):
358: 		return "api_v1"
359: 	case strings.HasPrefix(path, "/api/"):
360: 		return "api_unknown"
361: 	case strings.HasPrefix(path, "/static/"):
362: 		return "static"
363: 	default:
364: 		return "not_found"
365: 	}
366: }

368: type preparationRecord struct {
369: 	ID           string
370: 	Token        string
371: 	Session      string
372: 	Canonical    string
373: 	Fingerprint  string
374: 	Confirmation app.Confirmation
375: 	ExpiresAt    time.Time
376: 	Consumed     bool
377: }
378: 
379: type preparationStore struct {
380: 	mu      sync.Mutex
381: 	now     func() time.Time
382: 	id      func() string
383: 	records map[string]*preparationRecord
384: }
385: 
386: func newPreparationStore(now func() time.Time, id func() string) *preparationStore {
387: 	if now == nil {
388: 		now = time.Now
389: 	}
390: 	if id == nil {
391: 		id = randomRequestID
392: 	}
393: 	return &preparationStore{now: now, id: id, records: make(map[string]*preparationRecord)}
394: }
395: 
396: func (s *preparationStore) issue(session string, confirmation app.Confirmation) (*preparationRecord, error) {
397: 	s.mu.Lock()
398: 	defer s.mu.Unlock()
399: 	s.reapLocked()
400: 	if len(s.records) >= MaxPreparations {
401: 		return nil, errOperationCapacity
402: 	}
403: 	record := &preparationRecord{
404: 		ID: "prep_" + s.id(), Token: "confirm_" + s.id(), Session: session,
405: 		Canonical: confirmation.CanonicalRequest, Fingerprint: confirmation.InputFingerprint,
406: 		Confirmation: confirmation, ExpiresAt: s.now().UTC().Add(PreparationTTL),
407: 	}
408: 	s.records[record.Token] = record
409: 	copy := *record
410: 	return &copy, nil
411: }
412: 
413: func (s *preparationStore) consume(token, session, canonical, fingerprint string) (app.Confirmation, error) {
414: 	s.mu.Lock()
415: 	defer s.mu.Unlock()
416: 	record := s.records[token]
417: 	if record == nil {
418: 		return app.Confirmation{}, errConfirmationReplayed
419: 	}
420: 	if record.Consumed {
421: 		return app.Confirmation{}, errConfirmationReplayed
422: 	}
423: 	if !s.now().UTC().Before(record.ExpiresAt) {
424: 		record.Consumed = true
425: 		return app.Confirmation{}, errConfirmationExpired
426: 	}
427: 	if record.Session != session || record.Canonical != canonical {
428: 		record.Consumed = true
429: 		return app.Confirmation{}, errConfirmationMismatch
430: 	}
431: 	if record.Fingerprint != fingerprint {
432: 		record.Consumed = true
433: 		return app.Confirmation{}, errStaleConfirmation
434: 	}
435: 	record.Consumed = true
436: 	return record.Confirmation, nil
437: }
438: 
439: func (s *preparationStore) reapLocked() {
440: 	now := s.now().UTC()
441: 	for token, record := range s.records {
442: 		if !now.Before(record.ExpiresAt) {
443: 			delete(s.records, token)
444: 		}
445: 	}
446: }

449: 	digest := sha256.Sum256([]byte(session + "\x00" + token))
450: 	return hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])

133: 	if h.hub == nil || h.hub.ops == nil {
134: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, errors.New("operation capability unavailable"))
135: 		return
136: 	}
137: 	var payload startRequest
138: 	if err := decodeStrictJSON(r, &payload); err != nil {
139: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, err)
140: 		return
141: 	}
142: 	if strings.TrimSpace(payload.ConfirmationToken) == "" {
143: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, fmt.Errorf("confirmation_token is required"))
144: 		return
145: 	}
146: 	req, err := mapOperationRequest(payload.Operation)
147: 	if err != nil {
148: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, err)
149: 		return
150: 	}
151: 	current, err := h.hub.ops.PrepareOperation(r.Context(), req)
152: 	if err != nil {
153: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, err)
154: 		return
155: 	}
156: 	doc, err := h.hub.startConfirmed(sessionID(r.Context()), confirmationDedupKey(sessionID(r.Context()), payload.ConfirmationToken), func() (app.Confirmation, error) {
157: 		return h.preparations.consume(payload.ConfirmationToken, sessionID(r.Context()), current.CanonicalRequest, current.InputFingerprint)
158: 	})
159: 	if err != nil {
160: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, err)
161: 		return
162: 	}
163: 	w.Header().Set("Location", "/api/v1/operations/"+doc.ID)
164: 	w.Header().Set("Link", "</api/v1/runs/"+doc.ID+">; rel=canonical")
165: 	h.logOperation(r, "operation_started", doc.ID, string(doc.Kind), doc.State, "")
166: 	h.writeSuccess(w, r, http.StatusAccepted, doc, nil)
167: }

185: func (h *handler) handleActiveOperations(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
186: 	operations := h.hub.activeOperations(sessionID(r.Context()))
187: 	if h.runs != nil {
188: 		page, err := h.runs.Runs(r.Context(), app.RunQuery{Lifecycle: []app.RunLifecycle{"accepted", "queued", "running", "cancelling"}, TargetKind: "operation", Limit: 200})
189: 		if err == nil {
190: 			seen := make(map[string]bool, len(operations))
191: 			for _, operation := range operations {
192: 				seen[operation.ID] = true
193: 			}
194: 			for _, snapshot := range page.Runs {
195: 				if seen[string(snapshot.RunID)] || !snapshot.Lifecycle.IsActive() || snapshot.Target.Kind != "operation" {
196: 					continue
197: 				}
198: 				operations = append(operations, durableActiveOperation(snapshot))
199: 			}
200: 		}
201: 	}
202: 	count := len(operations)
203: 	h.writeSuccess(w, r, http.StatusOK, operations, &app.CollectionInfo{ReturnedCount: count, TotalCount: count})
204: }

206: func (h *handler) handleOperationCancel(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, id string) {
207: 	doc, requested, err := h.hub.cancelOperation(sessionID(r.Context()), id, "user_request")

209: 		snapshot, changed, cancelErr := h.runs.CancelRun(r.Context(), app.RunID(id), "user_requested")

211: 			doc, requested, err = durableOperationDocument(snapshot), changed, nil
212: 		}
213: 	}
214: 	if err != nil {
215: 		if legacyOperationID(id) {
216: 			h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusGone, "legacy_operation_not_retained", "This pre-durable operation is no longer retained. Refresh the owning product or inspect canonical workspace runs.")
217: 			return
218: 		}
219: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, err)
220: 		return
221: 	}
222: 	status := http.StatusOK
223: 	if requested {
224: 		status = http.StatusAccepted
225: 	}
226: 	h.logOperation(r, "operation_cancel", doc.ID, string(doc.Kind), doc.State, doc.Reason)
227: 	h.writeSuccess(w, r, status, doc, nil)

230: func (h *handler) handleOperationEvents(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, id string) {
231: 	lastID, err := parseEventID(r.Header.Get("Last-Event-ID"))
232: 	if err != nil {
233: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, err)
234: 		return
235: 	}
236: 	replay, events, unsubscribe, err := h.hub.subscribe(sessionID(r.Context()), id, lastID)
237: 	if err != nil {
238: 		if h.followDurableOperationEvents(w, r, id, lastID) {
239: 			return
240: 		}
241: 		if legacyOperationID(id) {
242: 			h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusGone, "legacy_operation_not_retained", "This pre-durable operation is no longer retained. Refresh the owning product or inspect canonical workspace runs.")
243: 			return
244: 		}
245: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, err)
246: 		return
247: 	}
248: 	defer unsubscribe()
249: 	flusher, ok := w.(http.Flusher)
250: 	if !ok {
251: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, errors.New("streaming unavailable"))
252: 		return
253: 	}
254: 	_ = http.NewResponseController(w).SetWriteDeadline(h.now().Add(MaxStreamLifetime + SSEHeartbeat))
255: 	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream; charset=utf-8")
256: 	w.Header().Set("Connection", "keep-alive")
257: 	w.Header().Set("X-Accel-Buffering", "no")
258: 	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
259: 	for _, event := range replay {
260: 		if err := writeSSEEvent(w, event); err != nil {
261: 			return
262: 		}
263: 	}
264: 	flusher.Flush()
265: 	heartbeat := time.NewTicker(SSEHeartbeat)
266: 	defer heartbeat.Stop()
267: 	lifetime := time.NewTimer(MaxStreamLifetime)
268: 	defer lifetime.Stop()
269: 	for {
270: 		select {
271: 		case event, open := <-events:
272: 			if !open {
273: 				flusher.Flush()
274: 				return
275: 			}
276: 			if err := writeSSEEvent(w, event); err != nil {
277: 				return
278: 			}
279: 			flusher.Flush()
280: 		case <-heartbeat.C:
281: 			if _, err := io.WriteString(w, ": heartbeat\n\n"); err != nil {
282: 				return
283: 			}
284: 			flusher.Flush()
285: 		case <-lifetime.C:
286: 			return
287: 		case <-r.Context().Done():
288: 			return
289: 		}
290: 	}
291: }

444: // followDurableOperationEvents is the compatibility projection for a run that
445: // was accepted by this or another local server but is absent from this
446: // process's transient operation hub.
447: func (h *handler) followDurableOperationEvents(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, id string, after uint64) bool {
448: 	if h.runs == nil {
449: 		return false
450: 	}
451: 	snapshot, err := h.runs.Run(r.Context(), app.RunID(id))
452: 	if err != nil || string(snapshot.RunID) != id || snapshot.Target.Kind != "operation" {
453: 		return false
454: 	}
455: 	if after > snapshot.LastSequence {
456: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusConflict, "cursor_ahead", "The event cursor is ahead of the durable operation.")
457: 		return true
458: 	}
459: 	if after+1 < snapshot.OldestRetainedSequence {
460: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusConflict, "replay_gap", "The requested operation history is no longer retained; refresh its canonical run.")
461: 		return true
462: 	}
463: 	flusher, ok := w.(http.Flusher)
464: 	if !ok {
465: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, errors.New("streaming unavailable"))
466: 		return true
467: 	}
468: 	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream; charset=utf-8")
469: 	w.Header().Set("Connection", "keep-alive")
470: 	w.Header().Set("X-Accel-Buffering", "no")
471: 	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
472: 	flusher.Flush()
473: 	heartbeat := time.NewTicker(SSEHeartbeat)
474: 	defer heartbeat.Stop()
475: 	lifetime := time.NewTimer(MaxStreamLifetime)
476: 	defer lifetime.Stop()
477: 	poll := time.NewTimer(0)
478: 	defer poll.Stop()
479: 	for {
480: 		select {
481: 		case <-poll.C:
482: 			events, eventErr := h.runs.RunEvents(r.Context(), snapshot.RunID, after, 512)
483: 			if eventErr != nil {
484: 				return true
485: 			}
486: 			for _, event := range events {
487: 				projected := durableOperationEvent(event)
488: 				if err := writeSSEEvent(w, projected); err != nil {
489: 					return true
490: 				}
491: 				after = event.Sequence
492: 			}
493: 			flusher.Flush()
494: 			snapshot, eventErr = h.runs.Run(r.Context(), snapshot.RunID)
495: 			if eventErr != nil || snapshot.Lifecycle.IsTerminal() && after >= snapshot.LastSequence {
496: 				return true
497: 			}
498: 			wait := time.Second
499: 			if len(events) == 512 || after < snapshot.LastSequence {
500: 				wait = 250 * time.Millisecond
501: 			}
502: 			poll.Reset(wait)
503: 		case <-heartbeat.C:
504: 			if _, err := io.WriteString(w, ": heartbeat\n\n"); err != nil {
505: 				return true
506: 			}
507: 			flusher.Flush()
508: 		case <-lifetime.C:
509: 			return true
510: 		case <-r.Context().Done():
511: 			return true
512: 		}
513: 	}
514: }

516: func durableOperationEvent(event app.RunEvent) operationEvent {
517: 	name := "progress"
518: 	switch string(event.Type) {
519: 	case "accepted", "claimed", "lifecycle":
520: 		name = "snapshot"
521: 	case "warning", "finding", "artifact", "terminal":
522: 		name = string(event.Type)
523: 	case "cancellation":
524: 		name = "cancel_requested"
525: 	case "recovery", "omission":
526: 		name = "recovery_required"
527: 	}
528: 	payload := map[string]any{"stage": event.Stage, "task": event.Task, "payload": event.Payload, "omission": event.Omission}
529: 	body, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
530: 		"operation_id": string(event.RunID), "time": event.CommittedAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
531: 		"sequence": event.Sequence, "payload": payload,
532: 	})
533: 	return operationEvent{ID: event.Sequence, Name: name, Data: body}
534: }

556: func newSprintRef(number, name string) string {
557: 	number = strings.TrimSpace(number)
558: 	name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
559: 	if number == "" || name == "" {
560: 		return ""
561: 	}
562: 	for _, r := range number {
563: 		if r < '0' || r > '9' {
564: 			return number + "-" + name
565: 		}
566: 	}
567: 	var slug strings.Builder
568: 	separator := false
569: 	for _, r := range strings.ToLower(name) {
570: 		switch {
571: 		case r >= 'a' && r <= 'z', r >= '0' && r <= '9':
572: 			if separator && slug.Len() > 0 {
573: 				slug.WriteByte('-')
574: 			}
575: 			slug.WriteRune(r)
576: 			separator = false
577: 		case r == ' ' || r == '-' || r == '_':
578: 			separator = true
579: 		default:
580: 			return number + "-" + name
581: 		}
582: 	}
583: 	if slug.Len() == 0 {
584: 		return ""
585: 	}
586: 	return number + "-" + slug.String()
587: }

594: func decodeStrictJSON(r *http.Request, target any) error {
595: 	contentType := r.Header.Get("Content-Type")
596: 	if !strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(contentType), "application/json") {
597: 		return fmt.Errorf("Content-Type must be application/json")
598: 	}
599: 	decoder := json.NewDecoder(r.Body)
600: 	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
601: 	if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
602: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid JSON request: %w", err)
603: 	}
604: 	var extra any
605: 	if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
606: 		return fmt.Errorf("request must contain one JSON value")
607: 	}
608: 	return nil
609: }

611: func mapOperationRequest(spec operationSpecRequest) (app.OperationRequest, error) {
612: 	if !validOptionalIdentifier(spec.Scope.Project) || !validOptionalIdentifier(spec.Scope.Sprint) || !validOptionalIdentifier(spec.Scope.Study) {
613: 		return app.OperationRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("operation scope contains an invalid identifier")
614: 	}
615: 	options := spec.Options
616: 	req := app.OperationRequest{
617: 		Project: spec.Scope.Project, Sprint: spec.Scope.Sprint, Study: spec.Scope.Study,
618: 		Stage: firstString(options.ToStage, options.Stage), Task: options.Task, Model: options.Model,

211: 			doc, requested, err = durableOperationDocument(snapshot), changed, nil
212: 		}
213: 	}
214: 	if err != nil {
215: 		if legacyOperationID(id) {
216: 			h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusGone, "legacy_operation_not_retained", "This pre-durable operation is no longer retained. Refresh the owning product or inspect canonical workspace runs.")
217: 			return
218: 		}
219: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, err)
220: 		return
221: 	}
222: 	status := http.StatusOK
223: 	if requested {
224: 		status = http.StatusAccepted
225: 	}
226: 	h.logOperation(r, "operation_cancel", doc.ID, string(doc.Kind), doc.State, doc.Reason)
227: 	h.writeSuccess(w, r, status, doc, nil)

230: func (h *handler) handleOperationEvents(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, id string) {
231: 	lastID, err := parseEventID(r.Header.Get("Last-Event-ID"))
232: 	if err != nil {
233: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, err)
234: 		return
235: 	}
236: 	replay, events, unsubscribe, err := h.hub.subscribe(sessionID(r.Context()), id, lastID)
237: 	if err != nil {
238: 		if h.followDurableOperationEvents(w, r, id, lastID) {
239: 			return
240: 		}
241: 		if legacyOperationID(id) {
242: 			h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusGone, "legacy_operation_not_retained", "This pre-durable operation is no longer retained. Refresh the owning product or inspect canonical workspace runs.")
243: 			return
244: 		}
245: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, err)
246: 		return
247: 	}
248: 	defer unsubscribe()
249: 	flusher, ok := w.(http.Flusher)
250: 	if !ok {
251: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, errors.New("streaming unavailable"))
252: 		return
253: 	}
254: 	_ = http.NewResponseController(w).SetWriteDeadline(h.now().Add(MaxStreamLifetime + SSEHeartbeat))
255: 	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream; charset=utf-8")
256: 	w.Header().Set("Connection", "keep-alive")
257: 	w.Header().Set("X-Accel-Buffering", "no")
258: 	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
259: 	for _, event := range replay {
260: 		if err := writeSSEEvent(w, event); err != nil {
261: 			return
262: 		}
263: 	}
264: 	flusher.Flush()
265: 	heartbeat := time.NewTicker(SSEHeartbeat)
266: 	defer heartbeat.Stop()
267: 	lifetime := time.NewTimer(MaxStreamLifetime)
268: 	defer lifetime.Stop()
269: 	for {
270: 		select {
271: 		case event, open := <-events:
272: 			if !open {
273: 				flusher.Flush()
274: 				return
275: 			}
276: 			if err := writeSSEEvent(w, event); err != nil {
277: 				return
278: 			}
279: 			flusher.Flush()
280: 		case <-heartbeat.C:
281: 			if _, err := io.WriteString(w, ": heartbeat\n\n"); err != nil {
282: 				return
283: 			}
284: 			flusher.Flush()
285: 		case <-lifetime.C:
286: 			return
287: 		case <-r.Context().Done():
288: 			return
289: 		}
290: 	}
291: }

444: // followDurableOperationEvents is the compatibility projection for a run that
445: // was accepted by this or another local server but is absent from this
446: // process's transient operation hub.
447: func (h *handler) followDurableOperationEvents(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, id string, after uint64) bool {
448: 	if h.runs == nil {
449: 		return false
450: 	}
451: 	snapshot, err := h.runs.Run(r.Context(), app.RunID(id))
452: 	if err != nil || string(snapshot.RunID) != id || snapshot.Target.Kind != "operation" {
453: 		return false
454: 	}
455: 	if after > snapshot.LastSequence {
456: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusConflict, "cursor_ahead", "The event cursor is ahead of the durable operation.")
457: 		return true
458: 	}
459: 	if after+1 < snapshot.OldestRetainedSequence {
460: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusConflict, "replay_gap", "The requested operation history is no longer retained; refresh its canonical run.")
461: 		return true
462: 	}
463: 	flusher, ok := w.(http.Flusher)
464: 	if !ok {
465: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, errors.New("streaming unavailable"))
466: 		return true
467: 	}
468: 	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream; charset=utf-8")
469: 	w.Header().Set("Connection", "keep-alive")
470: 	w.Header().Set("X-Accel-Buffering", "no")
471: 	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
472: 	flusher.Flush()
473: 	heartbeat := time.NewTicker(SSEHeartbeat)
474: 	defer heartbeat.Stop()
475: 	lifetime := time.NewTimer(MaxStreamLifetime)
476: 	defer lifetime.Stop()
477: 	poll := time.NewTimer(0)
478: 	defer poll.Stop()
479: 	for {
480: 		select {
481: 		case <-poll.C:
482: 			events, eventErr := h.runs.RunEvents(r.Context(), snapshot.RunID, after, 512)
483: 			if eventErr != nil {
484: 				return true
485: 			}
486: 			for _, event := range events {
487: 				projected := durableOperationEvent(event)
488: 				if err := writeSSEEvent(w, projected); err != nil {
489: 					return true
490: 				}
491: 				after = event.Sequence
492: 			}
493: 			flusher.Flush()
494: 			snapshot, eventErr = h.runs.Run(r.Context(), snapshot.RunID)
495: 			if eventErr != nil || snapshot.Lifecycle.IsTerminal() && after >= snapshot.LastSequence {
496: 				return true
497: 			}
498: 			wait := time.Second
499: 			if len(events) == 512 || after < snapshot.LastSequence {
500: 				wait = 250 * time.Millisecond
501: 			}
502: 			poll.Reset(wait)
503: 		case <-heartbeat.C:
504: 			if _, err := io.WriteString(w, ": heartbeat\n\n"); err != nil {
505: 				return true
506: 			}
507: 			flusher.Flush()
508: 		case <-lifetime.C:
509: 			return true
510: 		case <-r.Context().Done():
511: 			return true
512: 		}
513: 	}
514: }

516: func durableOperationEvent(event app.RunEvent) operationEvent {
517: 	name := "progress"
518: 	switch string(event.Type) {
519: 	case "accepted", "claimed", "lifecycle":
520: 		name = "snapshot"
521: 	case "warning", "finding", "artifact", "terminal":
522: 		name = string(event.Type)
523: 	case "cancellation":
524: 		name = "cancel_requested"
525: 	case "recovery", "omission":
526: 		name = "recovery_required"
527: 	}
528: 	payload := map[string]any{"stage": event.Stage, "task": event.Task, "payload": event.Payload, "omission": event.Omission}
529: 	body, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
530: 		"operation_id": string(event.RunID), "time": event.CommittedAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
531: 		"sequence": event.Sequence, "payload": payload,
532: 	})
533: 	return operationEvent{ID: event.Sequence, Name: name, Data: body}
534: }

556: func newSprintRef(number, name string) string {
557: 	number = strings.TrimSpace(number)
558: 	name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
559: 	if number == "" || name == "" {
560: 		return ""
561: 	}
562: 	for _, r := range number {
563: 		if r < '0' || r > '9' {
564: 			return number + "-" + name
565: 		}
566: 	}
567: 	var slug strings.Builder
568: 	separator := false
569: 	for _, r := range strings.ToLower(name) {
570: 		switch {
571: 		case r >= 'a' && r <= 'z', r >= '0' && r <= '9':
572: 			if separator && slug.Len() > 0 {
573: 				slug.WriteByte('-')
574: 			}
575: 			slug.WriteRune(r)
576: 			separator = false
577: 		case r == ' ' || r == '-' || r == '_':
578: 			separator = true
579: 		default:
580: 			return number + "-" + name
581: 		}
582: 	}
583: 	if slug.Len() == 0 {
584: 		return ""
585: 	}
586: 	return number + "-" + slug.String()
587: }

594: func decodeStrictJSON(r *http.Request, target any) error {
595: 	contentType := r.Header.Get("Content-Type")
596: 	if !strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(contentType), "application/json") {
597: 		return fmt.Errorf("Content-Type must be application/json")
598: 	}
599: 	decoder := json.NewDecoder(r.Body)
600: 	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
601: 	if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
602: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid JSON request: %w", err)
603: 	}
604: 	var extra any
605: 	if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
606: 		return fmt.Errorf("request must contain one JSON value")
607: 	}
608: 	return nil
609: }

611: func mapOperationRequest(spec operationSpecRequest) (app.OperationRequest, error) {
612: 	if !validOptionalIdentifier(spec.Scope.Project) || !validOptionalIdentifier(spec.Scope.Sprint) || !validOptionalIdentifier(spec.Scope.Study) {
613: 		return app.OperationRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("operation scope contains an invalid identifier")
614: 	}
615: 	options := spec.Options
616: 	req := app.OperationRequest{
617: 		Project: spec.Scope.Project, Sprint: spec.Scope.Sprint, Study: spec.Scope.Study,
618: 		Stage: firstString(options.ToStage, options.Stage), Task: options.Task, Model: options.Model,
619: 		Level: options.Level, Suite: options.Suite, Test: options.Test, Timeout: options.Timeout,
620: 		ForceReview: options.ForceReview, RestartReview: options.RestartReview, OverrideRationale: options.OverrideRationale,
621: 		ReviewFocus: options.ReviewFocus, Sources: options.Sources, Dimensions: options.Dimensions, Parallelism: options.Parallelism,
622: 	}
623: 	kind := strings.ReplaceAll(strings.TrimSpace(spec.Kind), "_", "-")
624: 	switch kind {
625: 	case "validation", "validate":
626: 		req.Kind = app.OperationValidate
627: 	case "sprint-status":
628: 		req.Kind = app.OperationSprintStatus
629: 	case "prompt-preview", "sprint-prompt":
630: 		req.Kind = app.OperationPrompt
631: 	case "dry-run", "sprint-flow-dry-run":
632: 		req.Kind = app.OperationFlowDryRun
633: 	case "sprint-flow":
634: 		if options.DryRun {
635: 			req.Kind = app.OperationFlowDryRun
636: 		} else {
637: 			req.Kind = app.OperationFlow
638: 		}
639: 	case "sprint-stage":
640: 		if options.DryRun {
641: 			req.Kind = app.OperationStageDryRun
642: 		} else {
643: 			req.Kind = app.OperationStage
644: 		}
645: 	case "sprint-stage-dry-run":
646: 		req.Kind = app.OperationStageDryRun
647: 	case "execute", "execute-start":
648: 		switch {
649: 		case options.Action == "status":
650: 			req.Kind = app.OperationExecuteStatus
651: 		case options.DryRun:
652: 			req.Kind = app.OperationExecuteDryRun
653: 		case options.Resume:
654: 			req.Kind = app.OperationExecuteResume
655: 		default:
656: 			req.Kind = app.OperationExecuteStart
657: 		}
658: 	case "execute-status":
659: 		req.Kind = app.OperationExecuteStatus
660: 	case "execute-dry-run":
661: 		req.Kind = app.OperationExecuteDryRun
662: 	case "execute-resume":
663: 		req.Kind = app.OperationExecuteResume
664: 	case "review", "review-start":
665: 		if options.Action == "status" {
666: 			req.Kind = app.OperationReviewStatus
667: 		} else if options.DryRun {
668: 			req.Kind = app.OperationReviewDryRun
669: 		} else {
670: 			req.Kind = app.OperationReviewStart
671: 		}
672: 	case "review-status":

674: 	case "review-dry-run":

679: 		} else if options.DryRun {

681: 		} else {
